environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) in private subnet running Node.js 14.x monolith. Instance is behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with no Layer 7 inspection. Security group allows inbound TCP/3000 from 10.0.0.0/8 CIDR. No request filtering or payload inspection at any layer. IAM role attached has SSM and CloudWatch permissions only.
